title: Create and print a variable
instruction: Create a variable called `greeting` that holds the string "Hello, Python!" and print it.
starter_code: # Create a greeting variable and print it

title: Swap two variables
instruction: You have two variables `x` and `y` with values 5 and 10. Swap their values so `x` becomes 10 and `y` becomes 5. Print both variables after swapping.
starter_code:
x = 5
y = 10
# Swap the values here
solution_code:
x = 5
y = 10
x, y = y, x
print(x)
print(y)

title: Check variable types
instruction: Create three variables: an integer, a float, and a string. Use `type()` to print the type of each one, each on a separate line.
starter_code: # Create three variables of different types and print their types
solution_code:
my_int = 7
my_float = 3.14
my_str = "hello"
print(type(my_int))
print(type(my_float))
print(type(my_str))
